title: Metering Service Billing Adjustment Limits and Bases by Meter Type
content:
The figures below are the **Metering Service** limits and bases that bound a billing adjustment for a meter test result, fixed per meter type.

## Period limits and posting threshold

| Meter type | Longest refund period, ending on the test date (months) | Longest backbill period, ending on the test date (months) | Smallest adjustment that is posted (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter | 12 | 6 | 1.00 |
| Standard AMI Smart Meter | 12 | 6 | 1.00 |
| AMI Bidirectional Net Meter | 12 | 6 | 1.00 |
| AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | 12 | 12 | 5.00 |
| AMI Interval Demand Meter | 12 | 12 | 5.00 |
| Primary Metering Installation | 24 | 12 | 25.00 |

In this knowledge base, "the meter type's refund limit" means the longest refund period above, "the meter type's backbill limit" means the longest backbill period above, and "the meter type's adjustment threshold" means the smallest adjustment that is posted.

## Bases recorded for each type

| Basis | Value |
|---|---|
| Error-start basis, used where no record shows when the error began (all types) | Midpoint between the later of the installed date and the last previous test date, and the test date |
| Charges corrected by an accuracy adjustment (all types) | Energy, demand and Power Supply Cost Recovery charges of each regular bill in the adjustment period |
| Rounding of adjustment kWh and amounts (all types) | Amount rounded to the cent after summing all affected bills |
| Rates that price corrected usage (all types) | Rates of the schedule in effect for each affected bill |
| Usage basis for a meter found not registering: Non-Communicating Opt-Out Meter, Standard AMI Smart Meter, AMI Bidirectional Net Meter, AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter | kWh of the same billing periods of the prior year, priced at the rates of the affected bills |
| Usage basis for a meter found not registering: AMI Interval Demand Meter, Primary Metering Installation | kWh and demand of the same billing periods of the prior year, priced at the rates of the affected bills |

## Reading the table

- The refund limit is 12 months for every type except the Primary Metering Installation, at 24.
- The backbill limit is 6 months for the three residential-class types and 12 months for the three commercial types.
- **Threshold boundary (hypothetical amounts).** For an AMI Three-Phase Commercial Meter, a calculated adjustment of 4.99 is below the 5.00 threshold; 5.00 is not below it.
